scope: independent raw-sample recomputation; final loss-aware UDP timing cohort only

metric_definitions.goodput: Actual unique verified delivered application payload bytes / receiver first-data-to-fixed-drain-cutoff monotonic duration; includes 100ms drain and control/barrier overhead; decimal MB/s and Mbit/s; primary median of seven per-round rates.
metric_definitions.latency_primary: Established application 64B request/verified64B response RTT and fresh first verified response setup are separate; primary median of seven per-round medians (256 RTT, 8 setup observations per round).
metric_definitions.latency_supplemental: Pooled 1,792 RTT / 56 setup raw observations and dispersion are supplemental only.
metric_definitions.loss: Actual receiver lost datagrams / offered datagrams by direction; no DATA retransmissions; duplicates and corruption separate; zero corruption verified.
metric_definitions.dispersion: Min/max/Q1/Q3/IQR/MAD over seven per-round primary observations.

reliability.candidate_fixed_client: hybrid binary; only relay varies by variant
reliability.environment_limitation: Private netns, 4 vCPU Linux host, same-host loopback observed application performance; not WAN capacity. Fixed support CPU0,1 can bottleneck.

statistics.primary_goodput: median of seven round receiver verified byte/duration rates
